title: Meeting for the first time, safely
summary: Simple habits that keep a first meeting relaxed and safe.

paragraphs: A first date should be about getting to know someone, not worrying. A few habits take care of the worry so you can enjoy the conversation.
Pick a busy public place you know, like a coffee shop or a restaurant at lunchtime. Daytime and a set length (“let's get coffee for an hour”) take the pressure off both of you.
sections.heading: Choose the place

paragraphs: Get there and home on your own. Driving yourself, taking transit or using a rideshare means you can leave whenever you like, and you don't need to share your address before you're ready.
sections.heading: Make your own way
Tell someone
items: Send a friend who you're meeting, where, and when you expect to be done.
Agree to check in with them afterward.

paragraphs: Stay in control of your drink and how much you drink. If something feels off, trust that feeling: you never owe anyone more of your time, and it's fine to leave politely.
sections.heading: Trust yourself

paragraphs: If someone makes you uncomfortable before or after you meet, use “Report or block” in the app. If you ever feel in danger, call 911.
